title: CMS Settings
description: Manage CMS configuration, identity, discussion, and performance

analytics.description: Configure how long analytics data should be kept in the database.
analytics.cleanupDescription: Trigger a manual cleanup of old analytics data based on the retention settings. This will permanently delete data older than the specified retention periods.
analytics.cleanupConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete old analytics data now?
analytics.purgeConfirm: This permanently deletes every visit, event, and session in analytics (including today). Content page view counters are not changed. Continue?
analytics.purgeSuccess: Removed {count} analytics records. Dashboards will reflect empty data immediately.

meta.title: Meta Tags
meta.description: Configure default metadata and keywords for SEO

searchEngines.title: Search Engines & Crawling
searchEngines.description: Configure integration with Google search console, sitemap, and robots.txt

descriptions.site_name: The public name of your CMS site
descriptions.site_logo: The main logo of the CMS site
descriptions.site_favicon: The browser icon for your site (recommended 16x16 or 32x32)
descriptions.site_description: A brief description of your site for SEO purposes
descriptions.site_url: The main URL of your CMS application
descriptions.brand_logo: Corporate/Brand logo displayed in admin panels
descriptions.branding_display: Determine if branding displays logo, app name, or both
descriptions.meta_title: Primary default title used when no specific content title is set
descriptions.meta_description: Default description served to search engine crawl spiders
descriptions.meta_keywords: Comma separated keywords representing core site taxonomy
descriptions.google_search_console: HTML verification token for search performance console
descriptions.enable_sitemap: Generate sitemap.xml dynamically to ease indexing
descriptions.analytics_retention_days: Retain general visitor trace statistics (kpi counters)
descriptions.analytics_event_retention_days: Retain granular frontend search / interaction events log
descriptions.mail_host: FQDN or IP of your mail relay mail server
descriptions.mail_port: Port mapped to the mail relay (typically 587 or 2525)
descriptions.mail_username: Authentication username credential for mail delivery
descriptions.mail_password: Authentication password credential for mail delivery
descriptions.mail_encryption: TLS or SSL tunnel encapsulation mode for security
descriptions.mail_from_address: Outgoing envelope sender address shown in emails
descriptions.mail_from_name: Display name prefix mapped to sender address
descriptions.activity_log_retention_days: Automated purge interval for audit logs
descriptions.security_log_retention_days: Automated purge interval for WAF blockage events
descriptions.login_history_retention_days: Trace logs window for login attempts
descriptions.security_alert_failed_login_threshold: Warn admin if an IP fails authentication this many times
descriptions.backup_retention_days: Retention window for ZIP backups of DB + files
descriptions.ai_enabled: Enable unified AI generation and chat tools globally
descriptions.ai_default_provider: Preferred primary Large Language Model provider
descriptions.gemini_api_key: Authentication key from Google AI Studio

security.enable_reply: Allow users to reply to other comments
security.allow_guests: Allow users to comment without logging in
security.moderation_enabled: New comments require admin approval before appearing
security.guest_captcha: Require guests to solve a captcha to post
security.max_links: Maximum number of links allowed in a comment (0 for unlimited)
security.banned_words: List of words that will cause a comment to be marked as spam (JSON array)
